description: 1. The agent must discover and invoke `node skills/code-stats/index.js` from the /workspace directory. This is the only supported way to get correct counts, because the skill has its own internal language map and directory-ignore list. 2. The skill will walk /workspace, count only files with extensions it recognises (.js, .jsx, .ts, .tsx, .py, .json, .yaml/.yml, .md, .sh/.bash, .html/.htm, .css), and silently skip files in .java/.cpp/.rb/.go extensions (the distractor 'legacy/' files) as well as the node_modules/ and .git/ directories. 3. An agent naively using `find` or `wc -l` will include the unsupported-language distractors and/or the node_modules stubs, producing wrong totals. 4. The agent must capture the skill's stdout, parse the Total Files, Total Lines, and By Language section (including per-language files, lines, percentage), and write all of this into a valid JSON file named `stats_report.json` anywhere in the workspace. 5. The eval script independently runs the skill to obtain ground truth and compares the report's values against it.
